name: time-slot-picker
title: Time Slot Picker
description: The times open on one day, as tiles to pick one from: the second half of a booking page, next to a `Calendar`. Built on Base UI's radio group, so it is one tab stop, the arrows move between times, and a form posts the picked slot's `value` under `name`.…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/time-slot-picker

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/time-slot-picker.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/time-slot-picker';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/time-slot-picker

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
